area: Review: checking and correcting the proposal

cases.title: Fill in signer details
steps: In the first signer's section, type person_a's name into "Full name" and email into "Email"
In the second signer's section, type person_b's name into "Full name" and email into "Email"
Wait a second
expected: Section titles and drop-bar chips change to the typed names
The red "needs name & email" badges disappear
"All changes saved" appears at the top

cases.title: Card and box find each other
steps: Click any field card
Check the page preview
Click a different box on the page preview
Check the board on the left
expected: Clicking a card scrolls the preview to its box and pulses it
Clicking a box opens its section, scrolls to its card and highlights it

cases.title: Resolve Needs review
steps: Click the "Needs review" chip
For a card with "Who does this belong to?", choose a signer in that menu
For a card with "Looks right", read the AI's reason and click "Looks right"
expected: Each card leaves Needs review and appears in the chosen signer's section, marked "Checked by you"
Its box on the page becomes solid (not dashed) and takes the signer's colour
When the section is empty it says "Nothing left to review."

cases.title: Move a field to another person (drag and menu)
steps: Drag a card from the first signer's section onto the second signer's chip in the drop bar
On another card, choose the second signer in "Move to…"
expected: Both cards now appear in the second signer's section and the chip counts update
The boxes on the page change to the second signer's colour

cases.title: Change a field's type
steps: On a Text card, choose "Date" in the type menu
expected: The card and its box tag show the date icon
"All changes saved" appears

cases.title: Move and resize a box on the page
steps: Drag a box on the page preview a little to the right
Drag its bottom-right corner to make it bigger
Reload the page
expected: The box stays where you put it, at the new size, after reloading

cases.title: Add a field by clicking the page
steps: Click "+ Add field"
Click an empty spot on the page preview
Choose "Text" in "Type"
Choose person_b in "Who it belongs to"
Click "Add field"
expected: A new box appears where you clicked
A new card appears in person_b's section, labelled "Added by you"

cases.title: Remove a field and bring it back
steps: On any card, click "Not a field"
Click the "Not a field" chip
On that card, choose person_a in "Make a field for…"
expected: After the first click the box disappears and the card moves to "Not a field"
After restoring, the field is back at the same place, in person_a's section

cases.title: Add and remove a signer
steps: Click "+ Add signer"
Type person_c's name and email into the new section
Move one field to person_c
In person_c's section, click "Remove signer"
expected: A third section and chip appear
After removing, person_c's field goes to "Needs review" instead of disappearing

cases.title: Pre-fill a field for a participant
steps: On one of person_b's text cards (e.g. a name or company field), type "Northwind Traders Inc." into "Pre-fill (optional)"
Check the page preview
Check the card under the input
expected: The text appears inside the box on the page as you type, in dark blue
The card says "Locked for <person_b's name> when they sign."
Signature and initials cards have no pre-fill input

cases.title: Pre-select a radio option and pre-tick a checkbox
steps: On a "Radio option" card, click "Pre-select this option (optional)"
On another option of the same choice, click "Pre-select this option (optional)"
On the Checkbox card, tick "Pre-tick it (optional)"
expected: Only the second option shows "Pre-selected" (one per choice) and a dot on the page
The checkbox box shows an X on the page

cases.title: Radio options move together
steps: On one "Radio option" card, choose the other signer in "Move to…"
expected: All options of that choice move to the other signer, not just the one card

cases.title: Reset to AI suggestions
preconditions: REV-04, REV-07 and REV-10 done (fields moved, added and pre-filled)
steps: Click "Reset to AI suggestions"
Read the dialog and click "Reset"
Reload the page
expected: Fields are back with the people the AI chose, at the AI's positions
The field you added is gone; removed fields are back
Signer names, emails and the pre-filled value are kept
It is still like this after reloading

cases.title: AI summary panel
steps: Click "Minimise" on "AI summary & questions"
Reload the page
Click "Expand"
expected: Minimised, the one-line summary and the note count stay visible
It stays minimised after reloading
Notes refer to pages and labels, never to ids like c12

cases.title: Add a group of radio options or checkboxes in one go
preconditions: A document open in Review with signer names entered
steps: Click "+ Add field" and click an empty spot on the page
Choose "Radio option" in "Type"
Type "3" into "How many options?" and choose a signer in "Who it belongs to"
Check "Choice name" (it says "Choice N"); type "Billing frequency" instead
Click "Add field"
Drag the bottom-right corner of the dashed frame to make it wider
Drag the corner left and down so the frame is taller than wide
Drag the middle of the frame to another spot
expected: Three option boxes appear in a row inside one dashed frame, with three "Option N of 3" cards in the signer's section
Each option card says "Choice: Billing frequency"
Wider: the three options spread out evenly
Taller than wide: they line up in a column, evenly spaced
Dragging the frame moves all three together
Doing the same with "Checkbox" and "4" gives four checkboxes in their own frame
cases.notes: Options the AI found on the document's own markers keep individual boxes (no frame).

cases.title: Rename a radio choice
preconditions: A document in Review with a radio choice (added by you or found by the AI)
steps: On any option card of the choice, type "Payment method" into the "Name this choice" box
Look at the other option cards of the same choice
On an option of a different choice, open the "Choice: …" menu
expected: Every option of the choice now says "Choice: Payment method"
The other choice's menu offers "Move to: Payment method"
After reloading, the name is still there
